name: Unmaker, Nihileon
body:
UNMAKER, NIHILEON
CR 20

XP 307,200
CE Gargantuan outsider (native, psionic, unmaker)
Init +6; Senses all-around vision, aura sight, darkvision 120 ft., lifesense 120 ft., pierce the veils; Perception +38; Aura phrenic overload (80 ft., DC 30)

DEFENSE

AC 37, touch 18, flat-footed 35 (+10 deflection, +2 Dex, +19 natural, –4 size)
hp 414 (24d10+264); regeneration 10
Fort +25, Ref +11, Will +25
Defensive Abilities all-around vision, dark mystery, ruinous shield; DR 10/-; Immune cold; PR 31
Weaknesses unstable resolve

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 120 ft. (perfect)
Melee 6 tendrils +33 (3d6+6 force plus energy drain and blighting presence)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks blighting presence, energy drain (2 levels, DC 30), psionic fist +2
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 20th; concentration +30)

Constant—aura sight, deathless form (immune to death from ability drain and death effects), energy adaptation, phrenic overload (DC 30, penalty to AC and DCs, confuses, automatically read minds), pierce the veils, slip the bonds
At will—ad nihilo*, aura of decay (DC 24, causes ability damage and reduces hardness), disintegration (40d6, DC 30), dispel psionics*, energy ballM (20d6–20 force, DC 30), energy burst (20d6–20 force, DC 30), energy current (20d6–20 force, DC 30), energy wall (DC 23), extradimensional waymaking*, interplanetary psychoport, planar travel, psychosis (DC 30, 4 targets), sever the strand, telekinetic force (625 lbs, DC 30), telekinetic maneuver (+6), wrench
3/day—energy carpet (20d6–20 force, DC 30), event horizon (DC 28, 20-ft. radius, persists for 20 rounds, 20-ft. radius pull), null psionics fieldM, psionic effigy*, quickened energy burst (14d6–20 force, DC 27), wall of ectoplasm
1/day—armageddon (DC 29), feed to oblivion* (DC 28, 2 targets), unravel psionics (DC 29) (powers do not include the +2 DC bonus from Greater Psionic Endowment)

STATISTICS

Str 36, Dex 15, Con 32, Int 29, Wis 32, Cha 31
Base Atk +24; CMB +41; CMD 63
Feats Deep Focus, Flyby Attack, Greater Psionic Endowment, Greater Psionic Fist, Improved Initiative, Metapsionic Ability (energy burst, Quicken Power), Power Penetration, Psionic Body, Psionic Endowment, Psionic Fist, Unavoidable Strike, Void Focus
Skills Bluff +37, Diplomacy +34, Fly +31, Intimidate +37, Knowledge (arcana) +33, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +33, Knowledge (geography) +33, Knowledge (nature) +33, Knowledge (planes) +36, Knowledge (psionics) +36, Knowledge (religion) +33, Perception +38, Sense Motive +35, Spellcraft +36, Survival +35
Languages telepathy 300 ft., truespeech
SQ no breath

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Blighting Presence (Su)

The impacts left behind by a nihileon’s attacks are left wasted and ruined. Any damage dealt by a nihileon is cursed and cannot be healed unless the caster succeeds at a DC 30 caster level check (this is a curse effect). In addition, any terrain within the area of one of the nihileon’s damaging psi-like abilities becomes wholly barren, unable to sustain any sort of life. This effect can be removed by an aura alteration power or greater restoration spell upon one creature, object, or 10-foot cube patch of terrain.

More powerful effects such as wish or reality revisionM cleanse one 10-foot cube patch per caster or manifester level.

Dark Mystery (Ex)

Any divination or clairsentience effects that would attempt to perceive or gather information on a nihileon automatically fail. The creature and any info on it simply do not show up. In addition, creatures which attempt to identify a nihileon and its abilities with a Knowledge check must succeed at a DC 32 Will save or be unable to identify it as a nihileon. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ABOUT

Nihileons are created not to fight individual creatures but entire armies or cities. Not only do they ravage large areas rapidly, but they also ensure that any realm they attack cannot easily be repaired or repopulated.

Rarely are nihileons deployed in groups larger than one, as such overwhelming force is scant in its necessity.
